Annual grain need met · work-limited supply

People are conserved. Annual grain supply uses each model’s own remaining rural population and field work (600 hours/worker/year; extraction 33.719% central or 14.049% low). Grain support is a ration equivalent, not a new population count. Seasonal food/work feasibility, warehouse capacity, handling staff and complete diets remain unresolved. Earth comparisons use exposed development data; this is not independent validation. The earlier pipeline failed its southern Mesopotamia blind check; this refreshed fit has no new blind qualification. Climate r44 is retained. Existing reach, trade and administration belong to release 4 or older labelled scenarios.
